episodes.title: The Spell of Skewed Legend is Momotarou
episodes.synopsis: In this segment, a pear-shaped capsule containing a rejected MOMO (Military convert Ops Mechanical Operative) android of the Kasuga Institute named MOMO9000 (Aiko) is lost in a road accident that caused it to fall into the river. It is later found by an old couple who mistake Aiko for Momotarō. After reading the story of Momotaro, Aiko begins her mission to reach Onigashima gaining allies in a dog (Liru), a monkey (Uma), and a pheasant (Pachira).

episodes.title: The Spell of Ifs is Dr. K-Ko

info.title: The Summer Hikaru Died
info.synopsis: Yoshiki e Hikaru sono due ragazzi coetanei cresciuti insieme in un piccolo villaggio. Un giorno, Yoshiki nota la presenza di qualcosa di diverso nel suo amico: una qualche entità ha preso il suo posto. Pur sapendolo, Yoshiki continua a essergli amico, ma nel frattempo nel villaggio iniziano a verificarsi strani incidenti...

episodes.title: Replacement
episodes.synopsis: Yoshiki confronts Hikaru about his suspicions and discovers the terrifying truth. Even though they try to live normally, eerie incidents begin to occur.

episodes.title: Suspicion
episodes.synopsis: While Yoshiki and Hikaru accompany their classmates to a creepy mountain trail, a mysterious man arrives at Kubitachi Village and begins investigating.

episodes.title: Denial
episodes.synopsis: Recalling childhood memories with Hikaru, Yoshiki continues to struggle with his complex emotions. Desperate, he reaches out to Kurebayashi.

episodes.title: Summer Festival
episodes.synopsis: As Yoshiki attends the summer festival with Hikaru, the village elders fret over the recent death and Tanaka ends up with more questions than answers.

episodes.title: Wig Ghost
episodes.synopsis: When Yoshiki's sister spots a creepy clump of hair in the bathroom, Hikaru visits the Tsujinaka home to investigate — but things take a deadly turn.

episodes.title: Asako
episodes.synopsis: Yoshiki and his classmates discuss a story their teacher assigned them. Later, at a sleepover, Asako's sharp observations put her in grave danger.

episodes.title: Determination
episodes.synopsis: After the sobering realization that Hikaru is truly dangerous, Yoshiki decides that he must act and invites his best friend to skip school together.

episodes.title: Contact
episodes.synopsis: Yoshiki and Hikaru investigate Nonuki-sama and its link to Kubitachi's history. While at the library, they get an important lead from a surprising source.

episodes.title: Old Man Takeda
episodes.synopsis: Kurebayashi shares her knowledge about impurities with the boys. Later, the elder Takeda loses his temper over Hikaru's ignorance of the Indo's history.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.synopsis: The boys' surprise encounter with Tanaka lands them in the hospital. When they return to school, Yoshiki pieces together the truth behind Nonuki-sama.

episodes.title: Indo`s Sin
episodes.synopsis: Though hesitant, Yoshiki asks his father about the Indo family's murky past and secret ritual. Later, Hikaru loses control at school and feels deeply shaken.

episodes.title: Its Place
episodes.synopsis: While everyone else attends the school assembly, Asako finds Hikaru wandering the halls. Alone at the beach, Hikaru reveals his final plans to Yoshiki.

info.title: The Darwin Incident
info.synopsis: Un'organizzazione eco-terrorista, nota come Animal Liberation Alliance, salva una scimpanzé incinta da un laboratorio di ricerca per permetterle di dare alla luce Charlie, un ibrido fra umano e scimpanzé che diventerà noto al mondo come primo esemplare di "humanzee". Quindici anni dopo, i genitori adottivi di Charlie sono pronti a lasciargli avere i primi contatti con il mondo esterno, permettendogli di andare in una normale scuola superiore. Qui il ragazzo farà amicizia con Lucy, una ragazza tanto intelligente quanto solitaria. Ma questo inizio di una vita normale va subito in frantumi quando l'ALA, ora diventata ancora più estrema rispetto un tempo, è intenzionata a trascinare Charlie nei suoi complotti terroristici.

episodes.title: Humanzee
episodes.synopsis: The Animal Liberation Alliance, a terrorist group, raids a research institute and takes away a pregnant chimpanzee. Fifteen years later, Charlie, the half-human, half-chimpanzee Humanzee born that night enrolls into high school. He befriends Lucy, but little do they know how fragile their peaceful days really are.

episodes.title: ALA (Animal Liberation Alliance)
episodes.synopsis: The ALA attacks New York City, killing several people in a bombing. When news about Charlie's past ties to the ALA resurfaces, the town grows suspicious of his terrorist connections. Unfazed, Charlie goes to school as usual, not realizing what the ALA has in store for him as a mysterious man approaches Lucy.

episodes.title: Heterosis
episodes.synopsis: Lucy visits Eva, the chimpanzee who gave birth to Charlie, at The Kornberg Primate Research Institute. There, she meets Dr. Fowler who tells her a few secrets about Charlie's birth. She later joins Charlie's family for dinner as Hannah celebrates Charlie's first friend, unaware that the ALA members are lying in wait.

episodes.title: One of a Kind
episodes.synopsis: Charlie suddenly goes missing. While Bert and Hannah search everywhere for him, Charlie is calmly confronting Rivera, Lippman and Min-su of the ALA. He gives them an ultimatum and things seem to be heading towards a peaceful conclusion until Rivera makes a drastic move.

episodes.title: The Struggle for Rights
episodes.synopsis: Charlie is finally released from custody with the help of Congresswoman Dafne M. Linares, who ran on the platform of animal rights. When he returns to school, however, the warm reception he once received is now replaced with scorn and slander. Despite all this, Lucy takes steps towards getting Charlie his civil rights.

episodes.title: Direct Action
episodes.synopsis: Charlie goes viral once again for stopping a fight between Ozzy and student activist Gare. Instead of thanking him, Gare questions why Charlie is not more passionate about animal rights. Disappointed with Charlie's stance, Gare livestreams about feeling powerless as an activist when he receives a mysterious invitation.

episodes.title: Red Pill
episodes.synopsis: Students panic and the world watches in horror as a masked man livestreams himself shooting students in Shrews High. Deputy Philip Graham storms into the school, but is shocked to find Charlie trying to save the wounded. Meanwhile, Lucy comes face to face with the shooter as he prepares for one final and very public message to Charlie.

episodes.title: Visitors
episodes.synopsis: Public anger over the school shooting leads to a growing number of attacks on vegans and activists nationwide. As anti-ALA sentiments intensify, misinformation about Charlie protecting the shooter raises suspicions about his terrorist connections, leading to a confrontation with the townspeople.

episodes.title: Bluebeard`s Castle
episodes.synopsis: Lucy runs into Deputy Phil and tells him the truth behind the pool incident ten years ago. As Phil questions his own opinion of Charlie, Hannah senses something has changed in her adopted son. That night, Lucy and Charlie exchange messages as usual. However, Lucy's unusual response raises Charlie's suspicions.

episodes.title: Door to Accelerated Advancement
episodes.synopsis: Charlie goes alone to save the kidnapped Lucy. After confronting the armed ALA members, Charlie finally finds Lucy with Rivera. Delighted to meet him in person, Rivera tells Charlie the truth about the ALA raid that rescued Eva fifteen years ago and its connection to Dr. David Grossman, Charlie's biological father.

episodes.title: Transfer of Ownership
episodes.synopsis: Charlie returns after rescuing Lucy to find his home engulfed in flames. He rushes in to save his parents, but it is already too late. Realizing their deaths are suspicious, Charlie quickly disappears into the woods to evade police capture. A manhunt ensues as the authorities discover that Rivera has also gone missing from custody.

episodes.title: Sexual Dimorphism
episodes.synopsis: After losing his parents, Charlie is adopted by Deputy Phil and his wife Grace. They start a new life together despite the media frenzy and Phil's suspension for choosing to protect Charlie. However, more change is on the horizon for Charlie as his latest medical exams indicate his body is undergoing a transformation.

episodes.title: Will
episodes.synopsis: As Charlie tries to return to a normal life, the nation is horrified to learn about the ALA's latest atrocity. Charlie seems to pay it no mind, though, and makes a visit to his biological mother Eva, who is on her deathbed. When Lucy finds a way to help Eva communicate, her final message for Charlie leaves everyone in shock.

info.title: NeoRanga (ITA)
info.synopsis: Tokyo, in una casa distante 12 minuti a piedi dalla stazione di Musashino vivono le sorelle Shimabara. Minami, la maggiore, è una giudiziosa risparmiatrice che da molta importanza alla sobrietà e odia il lusso. Yuuhi, la più piccola, frequenta la scuola elementare privata situata nel distretto di Shinagawa grazie ad una borsa di studio. La sorella di mezzo, Ushio, ha come caratteristica principale uno spiccato senso di giustizia, anche se ciò significa rischiare di perdere la vita. Le sorelle Shimabara sono orfane e vivono da sole di espedienti e sacrifici, ma quando le cose sembrano andare per il peggio, ecco arrivare un ragazzino di nome Joel, ossia loro nipote, figlio del primogenito della famiglia Shimabara. Il giovane non porta con sé buone notizie e a quanto pare qualcosa di sconosciuto sta per stravolgere le loro vite.

info.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
info.synopsis: Durante la "cerimonia della benedizione divina", il quindicenne Elma, che proviene da una casata di utilizzatori della Spada Sacra, manifesta invece la classe considerata difettosa del Cavaliere Pesante. Per questa ragione viene privato della sua posizione come prossimo capofamiglia della casata Edvan ed esiliato. La classe del Cavaliere Pesante ha delle statistiche poco bilanciate e delle abilità piuttosto inutili, inoltre, gira voce che solo i codardi e i pigri la ottengano, ma Elma sa che non si tratta solo di questo. Essendo un ragazzo che si è reincarnato in un videogioco a cui aveva giocato in passato, sa bene che in realtà la classe del Cavaliere Pesante è in realtà la più forte che esista. Usando la sua intelligenza e le conoscenze della sua precedente vita, Elma inizia la sua avventura nel mondo in cui si è reincarnato.

info.synopsis: In un mondo dove la magia è potere, Lent possiede un dono raro: può prestare i suoi punti magia agli altri. Grazie a lui, il gruppo degli “Skypiercers” è diventato leggendario, finché i suoi compagni, ormai forti abbastanza, non lo scacciano perché lo considerano inutile. Tradito, Lent scopre che il suo dono nasconde un potere segreto: può riprendersi la magia che ha prestato, con gli interessi.
